mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#1.zh: 数日后，郓城县。宋江在县西巷置了一所楼院，安顿阎婆惜，人称乌龙院。这日宋江正在院中歇脚，忽有一条大汉寻上门来，正是赤发鬼刘唐。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#1.t: A few days later, Yuncheng County. Song Jiang had set up a house in West Lane for Yan Poxi, known as the Black Dragon House. That day Song Jiang was resting there when a big man came to the door: 'Red-haired Demon' Liu Tang.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#2.zh: 押司哥哥，晁保正和众兄弟感念哥哥报信救命之恩，特差小弟送来一封书信、一百两金子，聊表谢意。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#2.t: Brother Clerk, Headman Chao and the brothers are grateful that you warned them and saved their lives. They sent me with a letter and a hundred taels of gold as a token of thanks.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#3.zh: 那日不过念着兄弟情分，怎好收这许多金子？书信我收下，金子只留一条，余下的还请兄弟带回山寨。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#3.t: That day I only did it for our friendship. How could I accept so much gold? I'll take the letter, and keep just one bar of gold. Please take the rest back to the stronghold.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#4.zh: 哥哥救了我们七个的性命，这点心意若都不收，小弟回去如何向晁大哥交代？
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#4.t: You saved the lives of all seven of us. If you won't take even this small token, how will I answer to Brother Chao?

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#5.zh: 你只说宋江心领了。山寨初立，正是用钱的时候。替我向晁保正和众兄弟问好，大家平安便是最好的谢礼。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#5.t: Just tell him Song Jiang accepts the thought. The stronghold is newly founded and needs money. Give my regards to Headman Chao and the brothers. Everyone staying safe is the best thanks.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#6.zh: 既然哥哥执意如此，小弟便带回去。哥哥保重，后会有期！
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#6.t: Since you insist, brother, I'll take it back. Take care, until we meet again!

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#7.zh: 宋江将书信和那条金子装进招文袋，随手搁在桌上，起身送刘唐出门。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#7.t: Song Jiang put the letter and the bar of gold in his document pouch, left it on the table, and got up to see Liu Tang out.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#8.zh: 夜里城中耳目多，兄弟一路小心。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#8.t: There are many eyes and ears in town at night. Be careful on the road, brother.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#9.zh: 阎婆惜，原是东京人氏，随父母流落到郓城。父亲病故，宋江施舍棺材银子，阎婆便将女儿许给宋江做了外室。近来她与宋江的同房押司张文远勾搭上了，一心嫌弃宋江。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#9.t: Yan Poxi came from the Eastern Capital and drifted to Yuncheng with her parents. When her father died, Song Jiang paid for the coffin, and Granny Yan gave her daughter to Song Jiang as his mistress. Lately she had taken up with Zhang Wenyuan, a clerk in Song Jiang's office, and wanted nothing more to do with Song Jiang.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#10.zh: 她见桌上留着一个招文袋，打开一看，里面有一条金子和一封书信。信中晁盖谢宋江报信相救，她便将书信和金子一并藏起。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#10.t: Seeing a document pouch left on the table, she opened it and found a bar of gold and a letter. In the letter Chao Gai thanked Song Jiang for warning and saving them. She hid the letter and the gold together.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#11.zh: 好啊，原来他与梁山泊的强贼勾结！有了这封信，还怕他不依我？
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#11.t: Well well, so he's in league with the Liangshan bandits! With this letter, how can he refuse me anything?

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#12.zh: 宋江送别刘唐回来，猛然想起招文袋还在桌上，进门一看，袋口已被打开。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#12.t: Coming back from seeing Liu Tang off, Song Jiang suddenly remembered the pouch on the table. He went in and found it had been opened.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#13.zh: 我的招文袋怎地开了？袋里的书信在哪里？
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#13.t: Why is my pouch open? Where's the letter that was in it?

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#14.zh: 书信在老娘这里。你私通梁山泊的强贼，还收了他们的金子，这回可瞒不过我了。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#14.t: The letter is with me. You're in secret league with the Liangshan bandits and took their gold too. You can't hide it from me this time.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#15.zh: 那不过是朋友的一封谢信。你把信还我，有话好商量。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#15.t: It's only a letter of thanks from a friend. Give it back and we can talk.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#16.zh: 要我还信，须依我三件事。头一件，把典我的文书还我，再写一纸休书，任我改嫁张文远。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#16.t: If you want it back, you must agree to three things. First, give back the papers that bind me to you, and write a letter of divorce so I'm free to marry Zhang Wenyuan.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#18.zh: 第二件，我头上戴的、身上穿的、家里使用的，都是你办的，也写一纸文书，不许日后来讨。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#18.t: Second, what I wear on my head and body and use in the house, you paid for it all. Write a paper saying you'll never ask for it back.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#19.t: I can agree to that too.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#20.zh: 第三件，梁山泊晁盖送你的一百两金子，快拿来给我！
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#20.t: Third, the hundred taels of gold Chao Gai of Liangshan sent you: hand it over, now!

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#21.zh: 那金子我只留了一条，在你手里；其余的已叫来人带回去了。宽限我三日，我变卖家私凑给你，你先把信还我。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#21.t: I kept only one bar of that gold, and it's in your hands; the rest I had the messenger take back. Give me three days and I'll sell some things to raise it for you. Just give me the letter first.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#22.zh: 公人见钱，如苍蝇见血，谁信你推了不要？明日到公厅上，看你还说不说没有！
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#22.t: A yamen man sees money like a fly sees blood. Who'd believe you turned it down? Tomorrow in court, let's see if you still say you haven't got it!

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#23.t: You really won't give it back?

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#24.zh: 不还！饶你一百个不还！要还，到郓城县里还你！
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#24.t: No! A hundred times no! If you want it, I'll give it back to you at the Yuncheng court!

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#25.zh: 宋江去夺书信，阎婆惜死死抱住不放，口里只叫「黑三郎杀人也」。宋江一时怒起，抽出压衣刀，杀了阎婆惜。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#25.t: Song Jiang tried to snatch the letter, but Yan Poxi clung to it, screaming 'Dark Third Son is murdering me!' In a burst of rage Song Jiang drew his knife and killed Yan Poxi.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#26.zh: 阎婆惜的娘阎婆听见楼下吵闹，急忙赶来，只见女儿倒在血泊之中。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#26.t: Yan Poxi's mother, Granny Yan, heard the commotion downstairs and hurried up, to find her daughter lying in a pool of blood.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#27.zh: 我的儿啊！宋押司，你……你杀了人了！
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#27.t: My child! Clerk Song, you... you've killed someone!

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#28.zh: 是我杀了她。我是烈汉，不走，随你怎么办。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#28.t: I killed her. I'm a man who owns his deeds; I won't run. Do as you will.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#29.zh: 事后阎婆扯住宋江要告官，宋江自知郓城再也留不得，只得趁夜逃走。
mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#29.t: Afterwards Granny Yan seized Song Jiang to take him to the magistrate. Knowing he could no longer stay in Yuncheng, Song Jiang had to flee in the night.

mainline/songjiang-yanshixi#30.t: Song Jiang kills Yan Poxi and flees Yuncheng.
